text:
Maya: Planning to flip the `enable_new_routing` feature flag for 11:00 PT tomorrow. Who's on deploy duty and can own smoke checks/rollback?

Sam: I can take the flip and smoke. Available 10:45–12:00 PT. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

Eli: I'll be on-call & ready to revert infra changes. Ping me 11:05 if any perf regressions.

Tian: Can you include the safe-default? We should set `enable_new_routing=false` as fallback in the config store and have the kill switch ready.

Maya: Yes — we'll keep safe default = false. Plan: 11:00 flip to true for 10% of traffic, 11:10 increase to 50% if all green, 11:30 full 100%. Rollback plan: immediate flip back to false + scale down batchers if latency > 200ms.

Sam: Smoke checklist:
- quick smoke: run 5 requests to /v1/generate and /v1/route
- confirm 95th p95 < 150ms (platform dashboard)
- spot-check 3 tenant-specific prompts
- confirm no dropped tokens on stamper nodes

Eli: Add: watch KV cache hit rate and token error rate for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Reminder: run command:
```
./ops/flag-toggle.sh enable_new_routing true --percent 10 --note "canary 11:00 PT"
```
(Logs go to #eng-platform-deploys)

Maya: Sam, please post in this thread when you start the flip and when you promote. Also mark timestamps for each step.

Sam: Will do. I'll start at 11:00 PT. Posting runbook entry now: https://confluence.redwood/infer/deploys/enable_new_routing

Tian: I'll hold the rollback token. If anything odd, I'll flip to false and call a quick 10m postmortem.

Sam: 11:00 PT — starting canary now. switching to 10%...
Sam: 11:03 PT — canary smoke passed, latency & errors look stable. promoting to 50%.
Maya: Thanks — keep us posted. :thumbsup:
